errors.evidence: The y-axis has major ticks at 74, 76, 78, and 80. Therefore, each major interval (格) represents 2%, not 1%.

The peak value for the F1 score (red line) at captured_distance=5 is visibly above the 78% mark. The reference description correctly identifies it as 78.2%. The value 77.9% is factually incorrect as it is below 78%.

The description states the value for Acc at captured_distance=2 is '约76.5%' and at captured_distance=4 is also '约76.5%'. However, the data point at x=4 is visibly higher than the data point at x=2, so reporting them as the same value is inaccurate.
